scenario: A customer asks you to build an AI chatbot because support tickets take too long to resolve.

choices.text: Build a RAG proof of concept
choices.rationale: You do not yet know the root problem.

choices.text: Understand the current support workflow and delay causes
choices.rationale: Start from the business problem and workflow.
Cost matters later, after the problem is understood.

explanation: The FDE should discover the workflow, bottlenecks and desired outcome before selecting a technical solution.
principle: Validate the problem before optimizing the solution.
